root.label: Seneca Nation opposes Lake Ontario renaming

events.label: Seneca Nation opposes Lake Ontario renaming

slots.name: treaty age
slots.sentence: The leader of the Seneca Nation in upstate New York is criticizing President Donald Trump’s decision to rename Lake Ontario as “Lake America,” saying it violates a more than 225-year-old treaty and shows a “blatant disrespect” for the Indigenous people who gave it its name in the first place.
